newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA BOURSES, RABSI UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA BOURSES, RABSI UNCHANGED.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Monday's 41.14 points as the local stock market was listless for a tenth day in a row, brokers said.

Razvitie Investment Fund's third issue were offered at 35 levs against par of 100 on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there were no bidders. Bank for Agricultural Credit shares were also offered there at 900 against par of 1,000 but no bids were received.
Varna Grand hotel shares were bid at 85 levs on the BSE, against par of 100 but there were no shares on offer, traders said.
There were no repo deal in treasury paper today.
